title: Probation, expectations, and the one-to-one you should ask for

videos.script: Most first jobs start with a trial period. In Brazil it is the contrato de experiência; elsewhere, probation. {{trial}} During it, either side can end the contract more easily, and at the end the company decides whether to keep you. {{decides}} Almost nobody tells a junior what they are being judged on. So the junior guesses, and guesses usually aim at the wrong thing. {{guess}} This lesson explains what the trial period is, gets the expectations written down in the first week, and sets up the one meeting that makes the rest of it predictable.
